servers.description: bsl-analyzer workspace profile (project index): code search (find_code / search_code), whole-config call graph (graph), metadata browsing (metadata), analyzer diagnostics (diagnostics), SDBL query validation/execution (query), live-IB BSL execution (execute) and debugging (debug). Local stdio server; run `bsl-analyzer mcp install` for the canonical machine-specific entry (absolute binary path + optional EMBEDDING_* for semantic search).

bsl-analyzer reference profile: 1C platform API reference and docs search (search: find_docs / search_docs), exact API syntax (syntax_help), ITS expert help (its_help). Local stdio server; covers the platform-documentation role.

v8std.ru standards knowledge base (read-only HTTP): 1C:Enterprise BSL/SDBL development standards, ACC/BSLLS/EDT diagnostics, aliases, relations, source URLs and clean Markdown (v8std_search, v8std_get_page, v8std_get_related, v8std_explain_snippet, v8std_explain_diagnostics).

1С:Напарник — AI code review and technical checking (check_1c_code, review_1c_code), AI rewrite/modify (rewrite_1c_code, modify_1c_code, ask_1c_ai), versioned platform docs (search_1c_documentation, onec_help, diff_1c_documentation_versions, config_help) and ITS standards (its_help, fetch_its). Requires a running 1С:Напарник MCP wrapper and a NAPARNIK_TOKEN; URL below is the default local wrapper port.
